name: Gaussian Mixture Tree Construction
definition: A probabilistic approach to identify distinct 3D plane instances by modeling the 3D scene in a tree structure constructed recursively from leaf nodes to the root node, using Gaussian Mixture Models to join nodes.
summary: Gaussian Mixture Tree Construction is a post-processing method that organizes 3D Gaussian primitives into a hierarchical tree to identify distinct 3D plane instances, explicitly modeling scenes as compositions of planes rather than focusing on rendering efficiency.
